thread:
chen: Heads-up — ran into an odd case in the sandbox where the autofallback kicked into 'soft-degrade' for one customer, but we don't have a clear trace why

sara: Can you paste the request id or example? we should be able to follow the decision path in the trace

chen: req=abcd-2026-03-23-77. The decision log shows 'error_rate_threshold' hit, but the telemetry sampling shows only 10% of events are being sent to the audit pipeline so we don't see the recent spikes

jordan: ah, sampler + quota interplay. Remember we added a quota-based short-circuit in the routing layer last quarter — it drops debug telemetry when route qps > 500

chen: right — that explains missing spans. But two UX questions: 1) should the console show "why" a fallback fired (operator-friendly) and 2) what do we show to customers in their app logs (privacy + security)

luis: My vote: console shows full operator reason + link to audit traces. Customer-facing events should be sanitized: reason code + non-sensitive metrics. e.g. "FALLBACK:ERROR_RATE(503)" not stack traces

emily: +1. Also: for soft-degrade we should include the sampled cluster of examples that triggered the decision (maybe 5 examples), but only when customer has opt-in to debug exports

ops-bot: deployment:autofallback@prod 1765432250 — feature flag 'autofallback-verbose-audit' toggled ON for sandbox orgs

chen: here's a small policy proto I'm proposing to keep the decision deterministic and auditable. want opinions on fields and defaults:

```json
{ "policy_id": "auto_fallback_v2", 
  "triggers": [
    {"type": "error_rate", "window_ms": 60000, "threshold": 0.05, "sampling": 0.2},
    {"type": "latency_p95", "window_ms": 300000, "threshold_ms": 1200, "sampling": 0.1}
  ],
  "modes": {"soft": {"reroute_to": "model-small", "sample_preview": 5}, "hard": {"reroute_to": "fallback-api", "notify_ops": true}},
  "audit": {"min_capture_rate": 0.01, "max_batch_per_min": 100}
}
```

jordan: two notes: (a) sampling on triggers should be orthogonal to audit capture rate — we need a separate "decision_trace" capture that forces 100% for canary orgs, and (b) defaults probably too permissive for latency threshold — 1200ms may flip for many seq lengths

sara: agree about decision_trace. UX-wise, console should show a timeline with: trigger event, sampled examples, routing action, and the policy snapshot that was in effect (versioned). Link to a rollback/playbook button too :point_up:

emily: How about we add a compact reason code system? like FALLBACK:ER(5%) or FALLBACK:LAT(1.2s,p95). Those codes could be searchable in logs and compact in customer-facing responses

luis: And we must record attribution metadata for billing/SLAs: which model served how many tokens during downgrade window. add fields: "attribution_model", "tokens_served", "window_start"

chen: Ops question — when we expose operator reasons, do we show raw classifier output (like error classifier top-k reasons)? that's sensitive

luis: don't expose classifier raw outputs. expose normalized reason list (e.g., ["http_5xx", "rate_limit"] with confidences rounded to .1). store full raw in KMS-protected audit bucket only

jordan: Implementation detail: decision_trace events should be written to a new 'fallback_decisions' topic with schema version. Also augment trace ids so we can replay policy evaluation in the simulator

sara: UX: Add a 'Explain this fallback' CTA in the operator drawer that opens the decision_trace and a short natural-language summary (auto-generated). Need to cap cost — only show full trace if org has 'debug exports' enabled

chen: Cool. Next steps: I'll update the proto with separate sampling vs audit config, add attribution fields, and add a flag for 'decision_trace_force_capture' per org. I'll sketch the console mockup and post a thread in product. Any objections?

emily: none from me. please tag me when you post the mockup — want to make sure preview examples are tasteful and redacted

jordan: I'll add the topic to the infra sprint — need a small stream processor and new topic. cc @ops-bot for deploy gating

ops-bot: ci/build 1765432379 — fallback_decisions topic + schema registered successfully

chen: thanks all. I'll open the PR with the updated policy JSON and a short migration plan for existing policies (v1 -> v2)

sara: nice. quick nit: include a migration safety gate that flips off decision_trace_force_capture for orgs with >100k qps unless explicitly requested

chen: noted. will add. :thumbsup:
